title: Borrow Error
summary: A borrow-checking rule has been violated.

title: Multiple Mutable Borrows
summary: A mutable reference to shared state overlaps with another active mutable or immutable reference.
example_bad:
let mut x = 0
a = &mut x
b = &mut x

title: Borrow And Mutation Conflict
summary: A value is borrowed while a mutation occurs through another path.

title: Use After Move
summary: A value has been moved and is used afterwards.

title: Shared State Without Annotation
summary: State from multiple actors must be annotated shared or single_writer.

title: Single Writer Violation
summary: single_writer state mutated from multiple locations simultaneously.

title: Weak Reference Upgraded Unsafely
summary: Weak reference upgraded but target has been dropped.

title: Lifetime Mismatch
summary: A reference outlives the value it points to.

title: Send Constraint Violation
summary: A value is being sent but does not satisfy the Send trait.

title: Implicit Clone On Large Value
summary: A potentially large value is being implicitly cloned.

title: Internal Error
summary: Compiler or runtime hit an internal invariant failure.

title: Patch Target Is Not A World
Validation Error
summary: Structural validation pass rejected the program.

title: Pulse Budget Alloc Violation
summary: Allocation in pulse with budget(alloc=0) violates real-time safety.

title: Pulse Budget Lock Violation
summary: Locking/ownership operation in pulse with budget(lock=0) violates real-time safety.

title: Pulse Budget IO Violation
summary: I/O operation in pulse with budget(io=0) violates real-time safety.
